protocol.purpose: Model-quality eval for Gapl's resume analysis: does the AI verdict track candidate fit?
protocol.status: PREPARED, NOT RUN - requires a separately approved inference budget.
protocol.caseCount: 30 = 8 archetypes x 3 quality tiers (24 matched-role) + 6 deliberately role-mismatched
criteria: Readiness-score monotonicity (strong > average > weak within archetype) - countable, but the tiers are set by fixture construction, so treat as preliminary.
Schema validity: every response must pass validateAnalysisPayload.
Verdict-band match: descriptive only; bands assigned from an explicit evidence checklist (shipped artifact, quantified impact, relevant experience), subject to independent review.

bandChecklist.Shortlist-band: fixture shows a shipped/deployed artifact AND quantified impact AND directly relevant internship or work experience
bandChecklist.Maybe-band: some relevant project evidence but missing at least one of: deployment, quantified impact, directly relevant experience
bandChecklist.Reject-band: little relevant evidence, or role mismatch (fixture's core skill set does not overlap the target role's core requirements)

protocol.rubricCaveat: Preliminary synthetic rubric: verdict bands and monotonicity expectations are derived from how these fixtures were constructed and need independent review before any results could be cited.
protocol.notes: Synthetic resumes only; no real personal data.

cases: resumes 01-24 use their archetype role+tier with band by quality tier; 6 mismatched cases: marketing-grad-strong vs SDE Intern, ece-engineer-weak vs ML Engineer, ux-designer-weak vs Data Analyst, backend-3y-weak vs Product Manager Intern, data-analyst-weak vs ML Engineer, ml-engineer-weak vs Growth Marketing Associate - all band Reject.
